senses.gloss:
mn. (-जः-जं)
1 Dust.
2 The pollen of flowers.
3 The menstrual excretion.
4 The second property of humanity, the quality of passion.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, &c., aff. अच्, and the nasal rejected; this word more commonly occurs रजस्, q. v.

(ऋ,) राजृ r. 1st cl. (राजते or irregularly रेजते)
To shine:
With निर् prefixed,
To overcome, to subdue.

m. (-यः)
A dog.
E.
रजम् dust, and शय who sleeps.

m. (-थिः)
Air, wind.
E.
रजस् dust, and सारथि charioteer.

m. (-कः)
1 A washerman.
2 Cloth, clothes.
f. (-की)
A washerman's wife or a washerwoman.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, (clothes,) ष्वुन् or क्वुन् aff.; in the latter case the fem. is रजिका a washerwoman, and रजकी a washerman's wife.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Ruling, a ruler.
2 Splendid, irradiating, bright in itself, and the cause of brilliancy in others.
n. (-कं)
An assemblage of princes.
E.
राजन् a prince, and वुञ् aff. of multitude; or राज to shine, aff. वुन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
White.
n. (-तं)
1 A necklace.
2 Silver.
3 Gold.
4 Elephant's teeth, ivory.
5 The name of a lake.
6 The name of a mountain, perhaps Kailāsa: see रजताद्रि.
7 White, (the colour.)
8 Blood.
9 An asterism, a constellation.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, &c., अतच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Silver, made of silver, &c.
E.
रजत silver, and अञ् aff.

m. (-तिः)
The monkey HANUMĀN.
E.
रजत silver, and द्युति lustre.

m. (-स्थः)
Mount Kailāsa, the residence of KUVERA and his attendant demigods.
E.
रजत white, (or silver,) and प्रस्थ table land.

m. (-द्रिः)
Mount Kailāsa: see the last.
E.
रजत silver, and अद्रि mountain.

n. (-नं)
Colouring, dyeing, painting.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, Uṇādi aff. युच्.

m. (-न्नः)
A sort of rice, of a superior quality, said to grow in the Āndhra country.
E.
राज, and अन्न food.

f. (-निः-नी)
1 Night.
2 The indigo plant.
3 Turmerick.
4 Lac.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, अनि Uṇādi aff., and ङीष् optionally added.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
रजनि, and कर who makes; also रजनीकर.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
रजनी night, and कर who makes.

m. (-रः)
1 A goblin.
2 A thief.
E.
रजनि, and चर who goes; also रजनीचर.

m. (-रः)
1 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin, a ghost.
2 A watchman.
3 A thief.
E.
रजनी night, and चर who goes.

m. (-न्धः)
The tuberose, (Polianthes tuberosa.)
E.
रजनी night, and गन्ध smell, emitting a powerful smell after sun-set.

n. (-लं)
Frost, hoar frost, dew.
E.
रजनी night, and जल water, falling at night.

n. (-खं)
Evening, beginning of the night.
E.
रजनी night, and मुख commencement.

f. (-सा)
A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor tristis.)
E.
रजनी night, and हास a smile; the flowers blossoming at night, and diffusing a powerful scent after sun-set.

n. (-जः)
1 The second condition of humanity, the quality or property of passion; that which produces sensual desire, worldly coveting, pride, and falsehood, and is the cause of pain.
2 Dust.
3 The dust or pollen of a flower.
4 The menstrual evacuation.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, to be attached to, Uṇādi aff. असुन्.

m. (-नुः)
1 A cloud.
2 The heart or mind.
E.
रञ्ज to colour, to feel affection for, and सानु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-लः)
A buffalo.
f. (-ला)
A woman during menstruation.
E.
रजस् dust, &c., and वलच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Affected, moved, attracted, or excited by.
E.
रञ्ज to affect, causal v., and क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Adorned, embellished.
2 Illuminated, irradiated.
E.
राज to shine, क्त aff.

m. (-न्धः)
Suppression of menstruation.
E.
रजस्, and बन्ध binding.

n. (-लं)
Darkness.
E.
रजस् dust, बल heap.

m. (-सं)
Darkness.
E.
रजस् dust, and रस essence, or perhaps this and the preceding should be the same.

m. (-रः)
A washerman.
E.
रजस् dust, dirt, and हर who removes.

m. (-ज्जुः)
1 A rope, a cord, a tie, a string.
2 A lock of braided hair.
E.
सृज to create, &c. Uṇādi aff. उ, and the radical स rejected, and the vowel changed to its semivowel.

m. (-कः)
Wild fowl.

m. (राट्)
A king, a monarch or prince.
E.
राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.

n. (-रं)
Tax or toll imposed by the king.
E.
राज, and कर tribute.

m. (-म्बः)
A sort of Kadamba.
E.
राज royal, कदम्ब Nauclea.

m. (-रुः)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
E.
राज royal, कशेरु scirpus.

n. (-र्य्यं)
Royal duties, state affairs.
E.
राज, and कार्य्यं act.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Royal, kingly.
E.
राजन a king, क substituted for the final, and छ aff.

n. (-लं)
A royal race.
m. (-लः)
A prince, a king.
E.
राज, and कुल family.

m. (-ण्डः)
The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
E.
राज royal, and कुष्माण्ड a gourd.

m. (-त्वा)
A king-maker, one who raises him to the throne, &c.
E.
राजन्, and कृ to make, क्वनिप् aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going to the prince or ruler, devolving or falling to the king, (as property, &c. to which there are no heirs.)
E.
राज the king, and गामिन् what goes.

m. (-रुः)
The king's spiritual preceptor.
E.
राज a king, and गुरु preceptor.

m. (-वः)
A sort of flat fresh water fish, commonly Phalai.
E.
राज shining, ग्रीव the neck.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Sharp, hot.
m. (-घः)
A king-killer, a slayer of sovereigns, a regicide.
E.
राज a king, and घ for घ्न, who kills.

राजचिह्न^1क
n. (-कं)
The male or female organs of generation.
E.
राज chief, चिह्न^2 mark, and कन् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321.
[2] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161123. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/321.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
Pulmonary consumption.
E.
राज royal, principal, and जक्ष्मन् for यक्ष्मन् consumption; also राजयक्ष्मन्.

f. (-म्बूः)
1 A large kind of eugenia or rose apple.
2 A sort of date tree.
E.
राज royal, and जम्बू Eugenia.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Plated, inlaid.
E.
राजत, and अन्वित having.

m. (-लः)
The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)
E.
राज royal, and ताल palm.

m. (-षः)
A cucumber.
E.
राज royal, and तिमिष a kind of gourd; it is also read राजतेमिष.

n. (-जः)
Majesty, kingly dignity.
E.
राज, and तेजस् splendor.

n. (-त्वं)
Sovereignty, royalty.
E.
राज a king, त्व aff. of the abstract; also with तल्, राजता.

n. (-ण्डं)
1 Punishment ordered by the king.
2 A baton, a sceptre.
E.
राज, and दण्ड a staff, &c.

m. (-न्तः)
An upper and foretooth, applied to the two middle ones.
E.
राज royal, and दन्त tooth.

n. (-नं)
A levee, an audience.
E.
राज, and दर्शन seeing.

m. (-यः)
A petty prince or chief, one something less than a king.
E.
राज a king, and देशीयर् aff. implying something less or defective, or with देश्य aff. of the same power, राजदेश्य m. (-श्यः).

n. (-रं)
The gate of the palace.
E.
राज for राजा king, द्वार gate.

m. (-हः)
1 Oppression, tyranny.
2 Rebellion.
E.
राज, द्रोह violence.

m. (-ही)
A rebel, a traitor.
E.
राजद्रोह, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Royal revenue or right to property.
E.
राज, and धन wealth.

mf. (-नं-नी)
A royal city, a capital, a metropolis.
E.
राज a king, धान holding, containing; also with कन् added in the n. or f. (राजधानकं-राजधानिका.)

m. (-र्म्मः)
1 Royal duty.
2 The duty of the military tribe.
E.
राज, and धर्म्म duty.

m. (-वित्)
A statesman, one who knows the duties of royalty.
E.
राजधर्म्म, and विटु who knows.

n. (-न्यं)
A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum, Rox.)
E.
राज royal, धान्य grain.

f. (-रा)
Royal state or function, government.
E.
राज, and धुरा a load.

m. (-जा)
1 A king, a prince, a sovereign.
2 A soldier by birth, a man of the regal and military tribe.
3 A master.
4 The moon.
5 A Yakṣa.
6 INDRA.
7 (In composition,) Royal, denoting eminence or excellence.
f. (-ज्ञी)
1 A queen, a princess, the wife of a king.
2 The wife of the sun.
3 Deepcoloured brass, consisting of three parts of copper to one of zinc or tin.
E.
राज to shine, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्.

m. (-यः)
Polity.
E.
राज, and नय conduct: see the next.

f. (-तिः)
Regal polity, civil and military government.
E.
राज, and नीति polity.

n. (-लं)
The emerald.
E.
राज royal, and नील blue.

m. (-न्यः)
1 A Kṣatriya, a man of the military or regal tribe.
2 A name of AGNI or fire.
3 A tree, (Mimusops kauki, Rox.)
E.
राज to shine, अन्य Uṇādi aff., or राजन् a king, and यत् aff.

n. (-कं)
A number of Kṣatriyas or men of the military tribe.
E.
राजन्य a soldier, वुञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्वान्-न्वती-न्वत्)
Possessing or governed by a just and active monarch, (a country, &c.)
E.
राजन् a king, (or by distinction a good king,) and मतुप् poss. aff., form irr.

m. (-लः)
A kind of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
E.
राज royal, and पटोल the same; also with कन् added, राजपटोलक.

m. (-ट्टः)
1 A gem, said to be an inferior kind of diamond brought from Viraśa Deśa, a country in the north-west of India.
2 A tiara or royal fillet.
E.
र ज a king, and पट्ट a bandage, worn in the tiara or diadem of a prince.

f. (-त्नी)
A queen.
E.
राज, and पत्नी wife.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 The planet MERCURY.
2 A Kṣatriya or man of the military tribe.
3 A soldier by profession, but one of a mixed birth or fabulous origin.
4 The son of a king, a prince.
f. (-त्त्री)
1 Arabian jasmine.
2 A bitter gourd.
3 The musk shrew.
4 A kind of brass or bell-metal.
5 A princess.
6 A woman of the Rajput tribe.
E.
राज a king or the moon, and पुत्त्र a son, a child.

f. (-का)
1 A kind of bird.
2 A king's daughter.
E.
राज a king, and पुत्त्र a child, कन् aff., fem. form.

m. (-षः)
A guard, a watchman, a constable, &c.
E.
राज, and पुरुष a man.

m. (-ष्पः)
A plant, (Mesua ferrea.)
E.
राज a king, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-कः)
The orange tree.
E.
राज royal, and फणिञ्झक a sort of lime.

n. (-लं)
A cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
E.
राज royal, and फल fruit.

n. (-रं)
1 A plant, (a sort of Justicia.)
2 Salt.
m. (-रः)
The jujube.
E.
राज royal, and बदर the jujube.

f. (-का)
A water-fowl.

n. (-कं)
A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus)
E.
राज royal, and भद्रक auspicious.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Belonging to or claimed by the king.
E.
राज, and भाज् who shares.

n. (-यं)
Royalty, sovereignty.
E.
राज a king, and भूष condition of being.

m. (-त्यः)
A courtier, a servant of the king, any public officer.
E.
राज, and भृत्य a servant.

m. (-ग्यः)
A tree, (Chironjia sapida, or Buchanania latifolia, Rox.)
n. (-ग्यं)
Mace.
E.
राज royal, and भोग्य enjoyment.

m. (-कः)
A large kind of frog.
E.
राज a king, and मण्डूक a frog.

m. (-ल्लः)
A king's wrestler.
E.
राज a king, and मल्ल a wrestler.

m. (-र्गः)
A royal road, one passable for horses and elephants, and forty cubits broad.
E.
राज a king, and मार्ग a road.

m. (-षः)
A kind of bean, (Dolichos catjang.)
E.
राज royal, and माष a sort of kidney-bean.

m. (-द्गः)
A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus.)
E.
राज royal, and मुद्ग P. mungo.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
Pulmonary consumption.
E.
राज chief, and यक्ष्मन् phthisis.

m. (-ध्वा)
An enemy, a rebel, one making war against a prince.
E.
राज, युध to make war, क्वनिप् aff.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Proper or suitable for a sovereign, princely, royal.
E.
राज a king, and योग्य what is fit for.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Silver.
E.
राज royal, and रङ्ग tin.

m. (-जः)
1 A name of KUVERA.
2 An emperor, a universal monarch, or king of kings.
3 The moon.
E.
राज a king, (of a king or kings,) or a Yakṣa, and राज sovereign.

m. (-र्षिः)
A kind of saint; that holy and superhuman personage which a king or man of the military class may become by the practice of religious austerities; seven classes of Ṛṣis are enumerated, the Devarṣi, Brahmarṣi, Maharṣi, Paramarṣi, Rājarṣi, Kāṇḍarṣi, and Śrutarṣi: the order is variously given, but the Rājarṣi is inferior to the four preceding ones, and the two last mean the inspired saints and supposed authors of the Hindu scriptures.
E.
राज king, and ऋषि a saint.

n. (-णं)
1 Royal insignia.
2 Any natural mark indicating royalty.
E.
राज, and लक्षण mark.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
A name of YUDHIṢṬHIRA.
E.
राज royal, लक्ष्मन् a mark or symbol.

m. (-खः)
A royal letter or order.
E.
राज, and लेख a writing; also राजलेख्यं, &c.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
Of royal parentage or descent.
E.
राज royal, and वंश family, यत् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Governed by a just and able monarch, (a country, &c.)
2 Royal, kingly.
E.
राज a king, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-र्त्म)
A royal or main road.
E.
राज a king, and वर्त्मन् a road.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Pæderia foetida.)
E.
राज a king, and वल surrounding.

f. (-ल्ली)
A small gourd, (Momordica charantia.) राज royal, and वल्ली a creeper.

f. (-लिः-ली)
A line of kings, a royal dynasty or genealogy.
E.
राज, and आवली a line.

f. (-तिः)
1 A throne.
2 A palace.
E.
राज, and वसति abode.

m. (-हः)
A horse.
E.
राज a king, and वाह a vehicle.

m. (-ह्यः)
A royal elephant.
E.
राज a king, and वाह्य a vehicle.

m. (-विः)
The blue jay.
E.
राज, and वि a bird.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Springing from a royal race.
E.
राज a king, वीज seed, and इनि aff.

m. (-क्षः)
1 The Piyāl tree, (Buchanania latifolia.)
2 A sort of tree, (Cassia fistula.)
3 Euphorbia of various kinds.
E.
राज royal, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-नः)
A plant, from the fibres of which a coarse cordage and canvas are prepared, (Corchorus capsularis or olitorius.)
E.
राज royal, and शन Crotolaria.

m. (-रः)
The Iliśa or Hilsa fish, (Clupanodon Ilisha, HAM.)
E.
राज king, and शफर another sort of fish.

f. (-य्या)
A royal seat or throne.
E.
राज a king, and शय्या a bed or couch.

n. (-नं)
1 A royal edict.
2 A royal badge.
E.
राज, and शासन an edict.

m. (-कः)
A sort of parrot, (Psittacus Lori.)
E.
राज royal, and शुक a parrot.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The royal Catta or umbrella.
m. (-ङ्गः)
A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus batachus.)
E.
राज royal, and शृङ्ग a horn.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Relating to, or derived, &c. from the quality of passion.
f. (-सी)
1 The goddess DURGĀ.
2 The state of being in this world or the next, in which the Raja Guṇa or quality of passion predominates: it is divided into three classes; the first class comprises the Gandharbas, Yakṣas, Guhyakas, &c.; the second, kings and heroes; and the third, boxers, wrestlers, gamblers, tipplers, actors, &c.
E.
रजस् the quality of passion, अण् and ङीप् affs.

f. (-त्ता)
Majesty, royal dignity.
E.
राज, and सत्ता existence.

n. (-नं)
A palace.
E.
राज a king, and सदन a dwelling.

m. (-र्पः)
A large kind of snake, (Boa.)
E.
राज, and सर्प a snake; the king of snakes.

f. (-भा)
A royal assembly or court.
E.
राज a king, and सभा assembly.

m. (-पः)
1 Mustard, (Sinapis dichotoma, or S. ramosa, Rox.)
2 A mustard seed, as a measure of weight.
E.
राज royal, and सर्षप mustard.

n. (-ज्यं)
Royalty, sovereignty.
E.
राज a king, सायुज्य state.

m. (-सः)
A peacock.
E.
राज royal, and सारम the Indian crane.

m. (-हः)
A great king.
E.
राज, and सिंह a lion.

n. (-यं)
1 A sacrifice performed^1 only by a universal monarch, attended by his tributary princes; as in the case of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, and others.
2 A lotus.
3 A mountain.
4 A sort of rice.
E.
राज a king, (by him,) and षू to be produced, to be effected, aff. क्यप्; or राज the moon, for the moon plant, of which the acid juice is drank at the ceremony, and सु to bring forth, the same aff., deriv. irr.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to a royal sacrifice.
E.
कन added to the last.

m. (-जी)
A priest officiating at the royal sacrifice.
E.
राजसूय, and याजिन् who sacrifices.

m. (-कः)
A courtier, a royal attendant.
E.
राज, and सेवक a servant.

m. (-न्धः)
A horse.
E.
राज a king, and स्कन्ध the shoulder.

n. (-स्वं)
Royal revenue, impost, duty, tax.
E.
राज, and स्व own.

m. (-सः)
1 A white goose with red legs and bill, or more properly perhaps the flamingo.
2 A drake.
3 An excellent king.
E.
राज, and हंस a goose, the king goose.

n. (-णं)
A city, a town.
E.
राज a king, and हर्षण delighting.

m. (-ली)
A royal elephant.
E.
राज a king, and हस्तिन् an elephant.

m. (-कः)
A sort of large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus.)
E.
राज a king, हासक diverting, pleasing.

f. (-ज्ञा)
A royal edict or command.
E.
राज, and आज्ञा order.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.)
E.
राज a king, and आङ् before तन to stretch, aff. अच्.

m. (-नः)
1 A tree, (Buchanania latifolia.)
2 Another tree, (Mimusops kauki.)
3 The Kiṃśuka, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
राज a king, and अदन eating; also राजातन, and राजादनफल.

m. (-जः)
A paramount sovereign.
E.
राजा, and अधिराज superior prince.

m. (-म्रः)
A superior sort of mango.
E.
राज royal, अम्र mango.

m. (-र्कः)
Gigantic swallow wort. (Asclepias gigantea, with white flowers.)
E.
राज royal, and अर्क swallow wort.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Royal, noble, fit or proper for a king.
n. (-र्हं)
Aloe wood, (Amyris agallocha, Rox.)
E.
राज a sovereign, and अर्ह proper.

m. (-कः)
An esculent root, a sort of yam.
E.
राज royal, आलु a yam, कन् added.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A gem, described as an inferior kind of diamond, brought from the country Virāṭa.
E.
राज a king, आवर्त्तं a turning; it is considered as a lucky possession for princes, though not esteemed as an ornament.

m. (-हिः)
A sort of snake said to be two-headed.
E.
राज royal, and अहि a snake.

f. (-जिः-जी)
1 A row, a line.
2 An unbroken row, a continuous line.
3 A small vessel of the body.
E.
राज to shine, इज् Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.

f. (-का)
1 Black mustard, (Sinapis racemosa, Rox.)
2 A field.
3 A line, a row, a range.
4 A continuous or unbroken line.
E.
राज to shine, क्वुन् aff., fem. form, or राजि as above, and कन् added.

m. (-लः)
A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.)
E.
राजि a line, and लच् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Attending on or living about a prince.
m. (-वः)
1 A large fish, (Cyprinus niloticus, BUC.)
2 A kind of deer.
3 An elephant.
n. (-वं)
A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.)
E.
राजी a line, a row, व aff.

m. (-न्द्रः)
An emperor.
E.
राज, and इन्द्र chief.

m. (-भः)
A state elephant.
E.
राज, and इभ an elephant.

n. (-ज्यं)
1 A government, a country, a principality, a kingdom.
2 Administration or exercise of sovereignty or government.
E.
राज for राजन् a prince, and यत् or यक् aff.

m. (-तः)
A prince who has lost his kingdom.
E.
राज्य, and च्युत fallen from.

f. (-तिः)
Deposal, loss of sovereignty.
E.
राज्य, and च्युति falling.

f. (-रा)
Administration, government.
E.
राज्य, and धुरा burthen.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Subversion of a sovereignty.
E.
राज्य, and भङ्ग a breaking.

m. (-भाक्)
A king.
E.
राज्य, and भाज् who has.

m. (-शः)
Deposal or loss of a kingdom.
E.
राज्य, and भ्रंश falling.

m. (-ष्टः)
A deposed sovereign.
E.
राज्य, and म्रष्ट fallen.

f. (-क्षा)
Protection or defence of a kingdom.
E.
राज्य, and रक्षा preservation.

m. (-भः)
Ambition.
E.
राज्य, and लोभ desire.

n. (-ङ्गं)
A requisite of regal administration; variously enumerated, as seven, eight, or nine, viz. first, the monarch; second, the prime minister; third, a friend or ally; fourth, treasure; fifth, territory; sixth, a strong hold; and seventh, an army; the eighth is the population or companies of citizens, and the ninth the Purohita or spiritual adviser.
E.
राज्य royalty, and अङ्ग limb or part.

m. (-रः)
1 Government of a kingdom.
2 Right or title to a sovereignty.
E.
राज्य, and अधिकार superintendence, &c.
